extracted.intended_audience: research administrators, grant officers, historians of science, and researchers seeking examples of past international travel awards
extracted.subtask_description: A machine-readable listing of awarded international travel and related research-support grants (names, purposes, events, locations, dates, durations, and dollar amounts). Useful for analyzing types and amounts of past travel support across disciplines and programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awarding program / organization
rubrics_metrics.description: Program headings and funding sources shown as section headers, e.g., 'NATIONAL ACADEMY OP SCIENCES-NATIONAL RESEARCH COUNCIL', 'NATIONAU INTERNATIONAL, AKD SPECIAL RESEARCH PROGRAMS', 'INTERNATIONAL COOPERATIVE SCIENTIFIC ACTIVITIES', 'ENTOMOLOGICAL SOCIETY OF AMERICA'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies the funder or program under which each travel/support award is listed; used to group and attribute awards to specific programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recipient name
rubrics_metrics.description: The grantee or traveler listed by name, e.g., 'ROWAN, EDMUND C', 'MITCHELL, LAWRENCE C', 'WAGONER, ANN', 'SHEPPARD, HARVEY E'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary named individual receiving the travel/support award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose / activity type (original phrasing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Purpose phrasing used throughout the listing, e.g., 'TRAVEL TO ATTEND', 'SUPPORT OF TRAVEL OF U.S. PARTICIPANTS TO', 'PARTIAL SUPPORT OF U.S. PARTICIPATION IN', 'TRAVEL SUPPORT TO ATTEND', 'TO SPEND A YEAR OF SABBATICAL LEAVE', 'TO CONDUCT RESEARCH', 'TO VISIT AND MAKE SURVEY', 'TRAVEL SUPPORT TO MAKE OBSERVATIONS', 'TO COMPLETE EDITORIAL WORK'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the reason for funding (attendance, research, sabbatical, lecture, survey, editorial work, support for U.S. participants). These purpose labels implicitly define eligible activity types for awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event / conference / institute name
rubrics_metrics.description: The specific meeting or program being attended, often in all caps, e.g., 'THE TWELFTH PACIFIC SCIENCE CONGRESS', 'SYMPOSIUM ON FOUNDATIONS OF THE ELECTRON THEORY OF SOLIDS', 'FOURTH INTERNATIONAL BIOPHYSICS CONGRESS', 'NATO ADVANCED STUDY INSTITUTE ON ...', 'INTERNATIONAL CONGRESS ON HIGH ENERGY ACCELERATORS'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Names the conference, symposium, assembly, advanced study institute, workshop, or other organized activity that justifies the travel/support award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location (city, country)
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographic location of the event or visit, shown as 'CITY, COUNTRY' (often uppercase), e.g., 'LENINGRAD AND MOSCOW, USSR', 'TOKYO, JAPAN', 'READING, ESGLASO', 'PARIS, FRANCE', 'GUILDFORD, ESGLASD'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies where the funded activity will take place; used to indicate international vs domestic travel and to categorize regional distribution of awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event dates / timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Date ranges or meeting dates provided for the event, e.g., 'NOVEMBER 59- DECEMBER 11, 1971', 'AUGUST 7-14', 'MARCH - APRIL 1974', 'SEPTEMBER 1 - OCTOBER 1, 1971'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the scheduled dates of the conference or activity; used to determine timing and overlap with award duration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program code / internal reference
rubrics_metrics.description: Parenthetical alphanumeric codes following event lines, e.g., '(C4lMtS)', '(K044t94y)', '(POJt7SS)', '(ZOOiSSi)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Internal tracking or program reference codes associated with each award entry; useful for cross-referencing administrative records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award duration (months)
rubrics_metrics.description: Duration given in months following many entries, e.g., '6 MONTHS', '4 MONTHS', '12 MONTHS', '8 MONTHS', '18 MONTHS'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the period for which travel or support is provided (short visits, multi-month sabbaticals, year-long awards).

rubrics_metrics.name: Award amount (dollars)
rubrics_metrics.description: Monetary amount awarded, shown with dollar sign and numerals, e.g., '$5,000', '$4,600', '$267', '$20,000', '$6,000'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the financial support allocated for the travel/activity; primary quantitative metric for the award.

rubrics_metrics.name: U.S. participant support vs. individual award
rubrics_metrics.description: Distinction used in entries such as 'SUPPORT OF TRAVEL OF U.S. PARTICIPANTS TO THE XVTH GENERAL ASSEMBLY...' and 'PARTIAL SUPPORT OF U.S. PARTICIPATION IN THE THIRTEENTH GENERAL ASSEMBLY...', versus single-person travel lines like 'TRAVEL TO ATTEND...'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Denotes whether the award is for supporting multiple U.S. participants' attendance or a single individual's travel; implies different eligibility/justification categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Activity subtypes / allowable activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Subcategories of funded activities appearing in text, e.g., 'TO CONDUCT RESEARCH', 'TO LECTURE AT', 'TO WORK WITH PROFESSOR', 'TO COMPLETE EDITORIAL WORK OF THE ACTA', 'TO MAKE OBSERVATIONS WITH THE WESTERBORK SYNTHESIS RADIO TELESCOPE', 'TO DEVELOP COOPERATIVE RESEARCH PROJECT'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows the range of funded scholarly activities beyond simple conference attendance—research visits, collaborative work, lecturing, editorial tasks, observational campaigns, and cooperative project development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discipline / subject area (implied)
rubrics_metrics.description: Scientific/academic field implied by conference or event titles, e.g., 'ELECTRON THEORY OF SOLIDS' (physics), 'BIOPHYSICS', 'PHOTOBIOLOGY', 'ASTRONOMICAL UNION', 'CHEMISTRY', 'MATHEMATICS', 'STATISTICAL MECHANICS', 'PHYSICAL ORGANIC CHEMISTRY', 'PLASMA PHYSICS'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to categorize awards by scientific discipline or subject area; the listing implies disciplinary eligibility and distribution of funds.
